description: This file contains utility functions to check the availability of time slots within a scheduling system, including functions to verify if a specific slot exists in a schedule and if a slot is available considering quick checks and schedule data.

methods.name: _isSlotPresent
methods.description: Checks if a specific time slot exists within a list of slots for a given date.

methods.name: _isSlotPresentInSchedule
methods.description: Checks if a specific time slot exists on a given date or its adjacent days within the schedule data.

methods.name: isTimeSlotAvailable
methods.description: Main exported function to determine if a specific time slot is available, considering quick checks and schedule data.
